structure: eye diameter (ED, greatest horizontal diameter of eye)
eye: eye diameter (ED); Methods say measurements were taken 'on the left side of the body whenever possible', side not stated for this value
method: linear measurement with a Mitutoyo digital caliper; Materials and methods > Morphological data: 'The following measurements were taken with a Mitutoyo digital caliper (to the nearest 0.1 mm):' followed by the list including 'eye diameter (ED, greatest horizontal diameter of eye)'. The paratype paragraph itself prints no unit; the unit is taken from the caliper sentence and from the abstract, which prints 'snout to vent length, SVL up to at least 45.5 mm' (the paratype's SVL = 45.5 in the same Mensural data sentence).
conditions: Cyrtodactylus (Geckoella) teraiensis sp. nov. Measured specimen: paratype NHM 2025/391 (BG-81277), adult male, same locality and collection data as the holotype NHM 2025/390 (BG-81266), Belbari Chisang Collaborative Forest, Bhaunne, Morang District, Koshi Province, Nepal. The paragraph under 'Variation and additional information from paratype.' opens 'The adult male paratype NHM 2025/391 (BG-81277) resembles the holotype except as follows:' and gives the Mensural data sentence quoted here (cut marked) followed by its Meristic data. The holotype's own ED (2.8) is on main from desk-d488 and is not repeated here.
